title: Context-dependent protein structure prediction analysis and complex stoichiometry inference with MultimerMapper.
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了MultimerMapper，一个用于分析和可视化多聚体蛋白结构预测集合的软件，利用统计和图论推断化学计量比及相互作用模式，虽非新预测方法，但为蛋白复合物结构计算分析提供了有价值的工具。
abstract: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have transformed the field of structural biology, notably with the accuracy level reached by AlphaFold in the prediction of protein structures. While cloud implementations have broadened access to these methods, there is still a lack of non-AI tools to systematically interpret and analyze the resulting data, especially under varying modeling contexts. Here, we present MultimerMapper, a pipeline and software suite designed to generate, extract, integrate, analyze, and visualize the behavior of multimeric systems in ensembles of overlapping protein structure predictions. It utilizes statistics, graph theory, and novel algorithms to interpret how protein-protein interfaces and protein conformations behave across different modeling contexts, under the premise that they vary depending on the components introduced into the predictions. Starting from a list of input sequences, a stoichiometric space exploration algorithm guides users in the generation of highly informative structure prediction ensembles. Through interactive visualizations, MultimerMapper highlights higher-order subassemblies, infers stoichiometries, and identifies alternative interaction modes and conformational changes statistically associated with the presence or absence of specific protein partners. MultimerMapper offers a new perspective on the dynamic nature of predicted protein complex structures, supporting researchers in the exploration of functional mechanisms and assembly paths.
abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 的进展已经改变了结构生物学领域，尤其是 AlphaFold 在蛋白质结构预测方面所达到的准确度水平。尽管云端实现拓宽了这些方法的可及性，但仍然缺乏非 AI 工具来系统地解释和分析由此产生的数据，尤其是在不同的建模情境下。在此，我们提出 MultimerMapper，这是一个流程和软件套件，旨在生成、提取、整合、分析和可视化多聚体系统在重叠蛋白质结构预测集合中的行为。它利用统计学、图论和新算法来解释蛋白质-蛋白质界面和蛋白质构象在不同建模情境下如何表现，其前提是它们会随预测中引入的组分而变化。从输入序列列表开始，一个化学计量空间探索算法引导用户生成信息量高的结构预测集合。通过交互式可视化，MultimerMapper 突出高阶亚组装体，推断化学计量，并识别与特定蛋白质伙伴的存在或缺失在统计上相关的替代相互作用模式和构象变化。MultimerMapper 为预测蛋白质复合物结构的动态性质提供了新视角，支持研究人员探索功能机制和组装路径。
